olga: Quick AH follow-up — clarifying next steps from the roadmap Q&A. Short list: migration helpers, timeline, and owners.
ryan: timeline check: when is the migration canary supposed to start?
olga: canary starts 2026-08-05 internal, 10% external 2026-08-19, GA 2026-09-10.
maya: docs ask — who owns the customer migration checklist and sample scripts?
olga: owner: maya (docs) + ryan (eng). due: 2026-07-20.
infra-bot: task created: "mig-checklist" assigned to #eng-infra, due 2026-07-20.
tom: ops question — what is the rollback policy if external canary spikes errors?
olga: automatic traffic trim to previous stable + 24h compatibility shim; ops keep emergency rollback steps.
ryan: I'll add a quick CLI test snippet to the migration doc and open a PR.
maya: noted — I'll draft the one-pager and include the CLI snippet; will request reviews by EOD tomorrow.
olga: action recap: 1) migration checklist + scripts (maya + ryan) - 2026-07-20; 2) canary schedule (infra) - starts 2026-08-05; 3) rollback/runbook confirm (ops) - 2026-07-15. Links: RFC: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/migration-2026. Ping me to be added as an owner. :white_check_mark:
